newsitem.title: USA: Allied Healthcare sees interest costs up.
newsitem.headline: Allied Healthcare sees interest costs up.

text.p: Allied Healthcare Products Inc said until it finds a long-term solution to its capital needs, it will experience a significant increase in interest expense.

For third fiscal quarter and nine months ended March 31, the maker of respiratory therapy equipment and other healthcare products reported net sales of $30.5 million compared with $30.3 million a year ago.
The company reported a quarterly net loss of $300,000, versus net income of $1 million a year earlier.
"Increased interest costs have impacted Allied's performance," said chief executive Uma Aggarwal.
"The company is continuing its efforts to negotiate a long-term solution to its capital requirements," he said.
